id: \bWant to trade it for my Munchlax?
en: \bWant to trade it for my Munchlax?

id: \bThanks! Don't let Munchlax get too crazy on you.
en: \bThanks! Don't let Munchlax get too crazy on you.
it: \bGrazie! Non lasciare che Munchlax ti faccia impazzire.

id: \bI don't live here. I just come when I can. It's a good vacation spot.
en: \bI don't live here. I just come when I can. It's a good vacation spot.
it: \bNon abito qui. Vengo solo quando posso. È un bel posto per le vacanze.

id: \rI never understood trading. Keep what you earned, not what someone else did.
en: \rI never understood trading. Keep what you earned, not what someone else did.
it: \rNon ho mai capito gli scambi. Tieniti ciò che hai guadagnato, non quello che ha guadagnato qualcun altro.
